body:
## What
Re-homes the fleet five-opcode WAL row law into tidepool (external bench lost) and ships the skill-stall telemetry emitter on the `runs.outcome` seam — the re-ranked dogfood queue item (4).

- **`tools/skill-stall.mjs`** — `buildRun()` mirrors the worker's run-row truncation contract (`task<=200, outcome<=32`); `stallRecord()` refuses non-finite `stalledMs` (never invents a measurement); `walChain()` seals emissions into BIND/LINK/VIEW rows, fnv1a-64, genesis `0x16`. Local receipt proves what was **emitted**, not that the pool accepted it — acceptance stays the worker's `/api/ledger` readback.
- **`tests/skill-stall.test.mjs`** — 32 pins: WAL row law ({args,cell,hash,op,prev_hash,seq} key set, op vocabulary, contiguous seq, hex16, genesis) re-derived with **deliberately independent code** (own canonicalizer + fnv1a-64, zero `tools/` imports) so a shared bug cannot blind both sides; emitter bounds drift-pinned against `worker/index.js`; determinism byte-identity; post-hash tamper named at exact seq; row-removal continuity break; stallRecord honesty.

## FAIL-first
Pristine `origin/main` worktree + this test file → `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` (tools/ absent), exit 1. Found-by-running: my first `verifyWal` hashed the row *without* the `hash` key instead of with an empty one — the fresh-chain verify pin caught it pre-commit (RED→fix→green).

## Suite
`npm test`: 18 smoke + 8 schema-drift + 32 skill-stall + 13 jev, all green on branch; README expected-tail + check counts updated. Worker untouched; main untouched.
title: skill-stall telemetry + v1 WAL row-shape pins (re-homed)
